bad_request.summary: 400 - request rejected by a state guard

conflict.summary: 409 - request conflicts with current resource state

not_found.summary: 404 - resource does not exist or is not yours

branded-calling_GenericErrorResponse.description: An error occurred. The response carries the standard Telnyx error envelope.

batch_id.description: Id of the batch this number was vetted as part of.

loa_document_id.description: Id of the Letter of Authorization document attached to this number's batch.

description.description: An optional note describing this document, for example what it proves.

document_id.description: Id returned by the Telnyx Documents API after you upload the file (upload via `POST /v2/documents`; see https://developers.telnyx.com/api/documents).

document_type.description: Type of supporting document. Pick the closest match to what the file actually contains; `other` triggers manual vetting and may slow approval. The matching short_name reference list is at `GET /v2/dir/document_types`.

PhoneNumberBatch.description: A phone-number batch groups all numbers added in a single bulk-add request. Telnyx vets the batch as a unit. The response embeds the full `phone_numbers` array so you can read per-number status without a separate call, plus a batch-level `status` summarising the unit's progress.

dir_display_name.description: The DIR's display name at the time the batch was read.

documents.description: Documents attached to this batch (e.g. a Letter of Authorization). Empty when none were supplied at add time.

phone_numbers.description: All phone numbers in this batch, with per-number status.

status.description: Aggregate batch status. Mirrors the values used on individual phone numbers (`submitted`, `in_review`, `verified`, `unsuccessful`, `permanently_rejected`, etc.).

submitted_at.description: When the batch was created (and implicitly submitted for vetting).

total_count.description: Number of phone numbers in this batch (length of `phone_numbers`).

PhoneNumberStatus.description:
Phone-number lifecycle status.
- `submitted` / `in_review` - Telnyx is reviewing the batch this number belongs to.
- `verified` - approved; the DIR's display identity will be shown on outbound calls from this number.
- `unsuccessful` - Telnyx rejected this submission; the customer may re-add to retry.
- `suspended` - temporarily disabled (e.g. by an active infringement claim on the DIR).
- `expired` - verification expired; re-add to renew.
- `permanently_rejected` - terminal; cannot be re-added on this or any other DIR you own.

detail.example: Provided documents do not establish business identity.

message.description: Customer-visible free-text comment from the Telnyx vetting team. Only the first entry of `rejection_reasons` carries this; the rest are `null`.
message.example: Please re-upload a clearer scan of the certificate.

branded-calling_Error.description: A single entry in the canonical Telnyx error envelope. `code` is the stable Telnyx error catalog id; the human-readable explanation lives at `meta.url`. `detail` is a context-specific message; `source.pointer` (when present) names the offending field of the request.

code.description: Stable numeric Telnyx error catalog id. See `meta.url` for the full catalog entry.

detail.description: Context-specific message describing what went wrong on this particular request. May embed offending values; do not rely on it for programmatic matching - branch on `code`.

meta.description: Carries `url` linking to the Telnyx error catalog entry for this `code`. Useful for forwarding the user to documentation.

pending_check_codes.description: Codes of the pending vetting checks (e.g. `loa_signature_valid`).

pending_check_ids.description: Set on `422 vetting_checks_incomplete` responses from `/admin/dir/{id}/approve` and `/admin/phone-number-batches/approve`. Lists the still-pending vetting check ids.

pending_check_labels.description: Human-readable labels of the pending vetting checks.

source.description: Optional pointer at the offending field of the request.

title.description: Short human-readable category, e.g. `Bad Request`, `Duplicate resource`, `Not Found`, `Forbidden`. Treat as advisory only - the stable identifier is `code`.

branded-calling_Errors.description: Canonical Telnyx error envelope. Returned on every 4xx and 5xx response from this service. `errors` is non-empty; multiple entries indicate multiple distinct problems with the same request (e.g. one entry per invalid phone number on a bulk operation).

errors.description: List of one or more error entries. Order is not significant.

branded-calling_PaginationMeta.description: JSON:API pagination metadata returned with every paginated list response. Page numbering is 1-based. `page_size` reports the number of items actually returned in `data` for this page; the requested size is taken from the `page[size]` query parameter.

page_number.description: 1-based index of this page. Echoes the `page[number]` query parameter (default `1`).

page_size.description: Number of items returned in this page's `data` array. Capped at 250.

total_pages.description: Total number of pages available given the current `page_size`.

total_results.description: Total number of items across all pages (excludes soft-deleted rows).

BearerAuth.description: Telnyx API key supplied as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. In production, auth may be validated by the API gateway and forwarded via Telnyx auth headers.

Payment.description: Machine Payment Protocol credential used on paid retries, sent as `Authorization: Payment ...`. Obtained by paying a challenge returned in the `WWW-Authenticate` header of a 402 response. This is not a Telnyx API key; initial challenge requests use standard bearer authentication instead.
